title: Yellow Resinous Mexican Wagyu Tacos Al Pastor
description: A Mexican dish featuring wagyu beef, served in tacos al pastor style with a resinous and fluffy texture, made with a blend of spices and a deglaze technique
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat, brushing the grates with olive oil to prevent sticking
In a large bowl, whisk together cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt and pepper, then add the sliced wagyu beef and toss to coat
Thread the beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece, then brush with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness, then transfer to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
In a large skillet, heat a couple of tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat, then add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning
Stir in the diced pineapple and roasted poblano peppers, cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, then season with salt and pepper to taste

Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds, then assemble the tacos by slicing the grilled beef into thin strips and serving with the pineapple and pepper mixture, topped with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro and lime wedges if desired
